alt: Audio recording of a voicemail from L.A. Care Health Plan regarding a formal grievance and legal notice (March 27, 2026).
full_text:
This forensic record consists of an audio recording of a voicemail from an L.A. Care Health Plan representative named Maribel, dated March 27, 2026. The document serves as direct evidence of the health plan’s attempt to initiate informal, off-the-record telephonic negotiations with the plaintiff just hours after L.A. Care’s General Counsel had formally acknowledged a legal notice concerning triple network default and fraud. This outreach represents a strategic effort to bypass formal written discovery and establish a back-channel communication line during a period of documented systemic failure.

The significance of this recording lies in its documentation of L.A. Care's reactive administrative posture. By attempting to resolve high-stakes legal and medical grievances via phone rather than the mandated written correspondence, the plan further demonstrates a disregard for established procedural protocols. Forensically, this voicemail provides an irrefutable timestamp of the plan's awareness of the litigation and its attempt to mitigate liability through informal channels, serving as a critical piece of evidence in the broader audit of L.A. Care’s administrative defaults.
